options.name: Bonded Weapon
options.benefit: Call a celestial spirit into one weapon for 1 minute per paladin level. The spirit grants a +1 enhancement bonus at 5th level and another +1 every 3 levels thereafter, which can instead fund legal weapon properties.

powers.name: Enhancement Pool
powers.summary: Grant +1 at 5th level, increasing by +1 every 3 Paladin levels to +6 at level 20.

powers.name: Weapon Properties
powers.summary: Spend the enhancement pool on axiomatic, brilliant energy, defending, disruption, flaming, flaming burst, holy, keen, merciful, or speed after providing at least +1 enhancement.

powers.name: Daily Uses
powers.summary: Use once per day at level 5 and one additional time every 4 levels thereafter, reaching four uses at level 17.

options.name: Bonded Mount
options.benefit: Gain the service of an intelligent and loyal mount functioning as a druid animal companion using paladin level as effective druid level.

powers.name: Call Mount
powers.summary: Call the mount adjacent to you as a full-round action once per day, plus one additional use every 4 levels after 5th.

powers.name: Celestial Template
powers.summary: The mount gains the celestial template and counts as a magical beast for effects.

powers.name: Spell Resistance
powers.summary: The mount gains spell resistance equal to Paladin level + 11.
